notes.title: Oculus VR Issues
notes.content: If you have issues with Oculus Tracking please start the game from the Steam Menu by Right clicking and selecting Run in Oculus Mode. Sometimes Steam VR and Oculus Runtime can have a conflict.

notes.title: Release Update
notes.content:
Hi All.

We wanted to give a quick update that we have pushed back the release date by a week as we wanted to give this title some extra polish, love and attention before going live. 

We hope you don't mind but we really want this title to be as memorable as possible and when making a title like this everything needs to be as near to perfect as possible. 

Team @ Apollo 11 VR HD
